title: Glia-Free Cortical Neuronal Feeding Schedule - Neuronal Morphology
author: Justin T Savage
materials: The following solutions should be prepared: a) 4% PFA in PBS – In a 50ml conical tube add one 16% PFA ampule (10ml), 26ml of ddH2O and 4ml of 10X PBS. Mix and place at 37˚C to warm up. For storing keep away from the light at 4C. b) Blocking and permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton) - This recipe makes 5ml of blocking solution, sufficient for 1 24-well plate. •2.4ml of antibody-blocking buffer •2.5ml of Normal Goat Serum (NGS) •100ul of 10% Triton. c) Primary antibodies solution: This recipe makes for 5ml, sufficient for 1 24-well plate. •4500µl Antibody blocking buffer •500µl Normal Goat Serum (NGS) •5ul of anti-GFP antibody

a) Secondary antibodies solution: This recipe makes for 5ml, sufficient for 1 24-well plate. 4500µl Antibody blocking buffer 500µl Normal Goat Serum (NGS) 5ul of anti-Chicken IgY (H+L) Secondary Antibody, Alexa Fluor 488

steps.title: Prepare 20 ml neuronal media
steps.instruction: In a sterile 50 ml tube combine Neurobasal Plus (19 ml), Penicillin‑Streptomycin (100×, 200 µl), Sodium Pyruvate (100×, 200 µl) and B27 Plus (50×, 400 µl); sterile‑filter through a syringe filter, place tube in the incubator with the cap unscrewed and let warm/equilibrate for at least 45 min (media becomes orange and bubbly).

steps.title: Add growth factors
steps.instruction: Immediately before use, add BDNF 20 µl, CNTF 20 µl and Forskolin 20 µl to the warmed media.

steps.title: Half‑media replacement (feeding)
steps.instruction: Remove 230 µl of old neuronal media from each well, add 250 µl of the freshly prepared media (containing growth factors if added), return the plate to the incubator and inspect neurons under a microscope for normal morphology.

steps.title: Prepare AraC‑supplemented media
steps.instruction: Prepare Neurobasal Plus + B27 Plus as in step 1, add AraC at a 1:10 000 dilution, warm/equilibrate for at least 45 min with the cap unscrewed before use.

substeps.instruction: Lipofectamine solution: mix 100 µl Opti‑MEM with 2 µl Lipofectamine 2000; incubate 5 min at room temperature.
DNA‑Lipofectamine mixture: mix 100 µl Opti‑MEM, 2 µl Lipofectamine 2000 and 2 µl of 0.5 µg/µl GFP plasmid; incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Combine the Lipofectamine solution with the DNA‑Lipofectamine mixture; incubate 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfect neurons
steps.instruction: In a biosafety cabinet aspirate 300 µl of medium from each well (save in a sterile tube), add 200 µl of the transfection mixture, incubate 2 h at 37 °C, then remove all medium and replace with a 1:1 mixture of saved medium and fresh neuronal medium; return the plate to the incubator and check morphology under a microscope.

steps.title: Prepare additive‑treated NGM
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh Neurobasal Plus + B27 as in step 1, warm/equilibrate ≥45 min with cap unscrewed, place the NGM on ice, add the appropriate additive (ACM 100 µg/ml, Spermidine 10 nM, or vehicle equivalent volume), then equilibrate in a 37 °C, 10 % CO₂ incubator before use; replace half of the existing media (remove 230 µl, add 250 µl additive‑treated NGM), store in the incubator and inspect neurons for normal morphology.

steps.title: Fix neurons with PFA
steps.instruction: In a chemical fume hood aspirate all media from the wells and immediately add 500 µl warm 4 % paraformaldehyde to each well; fix for 7 min at room temperature, then wash 3 times with PBS.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl blocking solution to each well and incubate 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Remove the blocking solution, add 200 µl primary antibody solution to each well and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Remove primary antibody solution, wash 3 times with PBS, add 200 µl secondary antibody solution, incubate 3 h at room temperature protected from light, then wash 3 times with PBS.

steps.title: Mount coverslips
steps.instruction: Place each coverslip onto a slide with one small drop of VECTASHIELD Antifade Mounting Medium containing DAPI, seal with nail polish, let dry at room temperature for at least 30 min and store the slides at 4 °C.

steps.title: Acquire fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Using a fluorescence microscope (e.g., Keyence BZ‑X800) capture images at 20× magnification.

steps.title: Analyze dendrite length
steps.instruction: Manually measure dendrite length with the NeuronJ plugin in FIJI software.
